rows.sentence: The document requires closure at Saturday midnight:
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document expressly requires bottle clubs in unincorporated areas to close at midnight Saturday.

rows.sentence: - Closing hours: "All bottle clubs located in the unincorporated areas of the county, shall remain closed from the hours of 3:00 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. on each day of the week except that all such bottle clubs shall remain closed from midnight on each Saturday until 7:00 a.m. on the following Monday." (doc.txt)
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The quoted rule states both the usual daily closure and the longer weekend closure.

rows.sentence: - Scope: "the unincorporated areas of the county and any municipality which has not adopted an ordinance" (doc.txt).
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: As a statement of scope, the truncated quote omits that only an ordinance covering the regulated subject matter, activity, or conduct affects whether the chapter applies in a municipality.

rows.sentence: - Bottle club: a place where products are sold "with the knowledge... that same will be... mixed... with... an alcoholic beverage" (doc.txt).
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The abbreviated definition omits the requirements of consideration and on-premises consumption, and the document includes products dispensed, served, or provided, not just sold.

rows.sentence: - General on-premises hours: "between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 2:00 a.m. on all days of the week except Sunday"; Sunday "between the hours of 11:00 a.m. Sunday and 2:00 a.m. of the following day" (doc.txt).
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The quoted times match the general on-premises schedule for licensed establishments. The sentence does not claim there are no exceptions.

rows.sentence: - Violation: "a misdemeanor of the second degree" (doc.txt).
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly classifies a violation of the chapter as a second-degree misdemeanor.
